title: research: all-endpoint nonlinear recovery obstruction for PR2918
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

PR #2918 excludes scalar paired extraction of helper408 at one rank-seven endpoint. This package strengthens that fixed-word obstruction: for both pinned PR2894 providers, every endpoint of rank at most seven prevents exact recovery of any nonconstant eligible-input function, including arbitrary nonlinear decoding, eligible-only entrance recoding, and finite appended processing with fixed, monotone frame dependencies.

The exact census covers all **43,435 rank-seven subspaces**, grouped into **239 complete terminal supports**. Every support has a purely scalar forbidden-input minor with a dyadic-unit determinant. Independent protected inputs can therefore mask every eligible-input change. The known PR2908 rank-eight pre/post pair still passes, giving sharpness for every nonzero dyadic module within this frozen interface.

This is finite exhaustive evidence plus a written all-parameter proof. It is not a word-independent rank-eight bound, a new supplier, a paid-cost improvement, or a new κ. The entrance cut, independent dirty inputs, inherited center-cut frame convention, fixed output identities, and complete data/control dependencies are explicit. Changed words, extra observations, new warp resets and free pooling across incomparable endpoints are outside the result. Native/physical realization, complete recursive costs and outer admission remain unproved here.

## Task and overlap

This does not satisfy the card's positive changed-interface construction gate; it rules out endpoint-only repairs under a larger decoding/causal contract.
- Scientific source: #2918 at `9360ba7312cf8961e672e9eb26c612719028d39d`; #2908 at `51309592971e3b5be935599eed2a95404dc7781e`; #2894 at `18d03c447886895ef9abf888398178e0428533ca`.
- Nearest comparison: #2979 at `be191346391661f4d35fc0d1508d0a6029572576` already contains all-endpoint pairing screens on later words and a changed-word rank-seven positive. The addition here is the unit-minor census and nonlinear causal consequence for the two old pinned words. The underlying indistinguishability/quotient principles are standard.
- [Canonical investigation in Discussion #2612](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2612#discussioncomment-18970763). Live overlap refresh completed at 14:23 UTC with complete pagination over 290 open PRs and 1,943 discussion records, plus local package/ledger coverage of closed work. It does not search all diffs or establish literature novelty.

## Validation

CPython **3.12.12**, standard library only:

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/rank7-terminal-information-barrier
python3 scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/rank7-terminal-information-barrier
```

Both pass at reviewed head `0a632b00ef59a9f43b1f6c7965ff1ca7a3f188f3`. The first runs two exact implementations under `-I -O -B`: the authenticated predecessor forward engine with a new census, and a separately written reverse-adjoint/RREF/Bareiss verifier. Both consume the fixed certificate and check the rank-eight positive. The primary has eight rejecting controls per provider; the independent path has seven with exact expected diagnostics. Source pins and all 13 package/input files match the commit.

Fresh pre-submission mathematical, verifier and packaging reviews led to explicit cut/control/ancilla premises, nonzero-module sharpness, and corrected changed-scope metadata. No unresolved issue was found in that declared domain. See [VALIDATION.md](https://github.com/RossRichardson/integer-mult-bounds/blob/0a632b00ef59a9f43b1f6c7965ff1ca7a3f188f3/research/rank7-terminal-information-barrier/VALIDATION.md) for the evidence boundary. Hosted CI is separate. No full historical supplier suite, selected cold replay, formal-kernel proof or independent human review is claimed. Only the new package changes; predecessor sources and selected records are unchanged.

[TASK.json](https://github.com/RossRichardson/integer-mult-bounds/blob/0a632b00ef59a9f43b1f6c7965ff1ca7a3f188f3/research/rank7-terminal-information-barrier/TASK.json) and the [README](https://github.com/RossRichardson/integer-mult-bounds/blob/0a632b00ef59a9f43b1f6c7965ff1ca7a3f188f3/research/rank7-terminal-information-barrier/README.md#open-next-questions) identify the bounded follow-up: choose one existing changed-word rank-seven positive example, determine exactly how it destroys the certified nuisance block, and bind the entire entrance, source, restoration and recursive bill. This could identify a useful paid escape; a rank defect alone neither constructs nor prices it. No further synthesis or stronger bound is claimed in this PR.
